w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Redactor mauled Maya (-55 health) over 15 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE FOCUS GROUP! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE TERMS OF SERVICE! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — The Callback. It's here.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Fully identify 3 plants (knowledge level 3) within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "It is today. You dreamed about the cameras. Everyone did. The village is very quiet."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (13/9/7), with 5 wave-4 fought, 6 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 14 · Craft 14 · Talk 14 · Explore 28 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Chloe Dubois ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
